scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Did you get my email? The annual meeting is on November 21.
scene.zh: 你有收到我的 email 嗎？年度大會訂在十一月二十一日。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: We'll all gather at the Riverside Hotel, with a few business associates.
scene.zh: 大家會在 Riverside Hotel 聚一聚，還有幾位生意上的夥伴也會來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Previously, only executives gave reports. This year, you'll present Lantern.
scene.zh: 以前只有高階主管上台報告。今年由你來報告 Lantern。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How much time will I have for the Lantern results?
scene.zh: Lantern 的成果報告我大概有多少時間？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You'll have 45 minutes. Lunch is catered, so we can't run late.
scene.zh: 你有四十五分鐘。午餐是外燴，所以時間不能拖。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Mr. Hughes can't fly in from England this time, which is too bad.
scene.zh: Mr. Hughes 這次沒辦法從英國飛過來，真可惜。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Could we ask Mr. Hughes to join us by video?
scene.zh: 我們可以請 Mr. Hughes 用視訊參加嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good idea. The meeting is internal, but he's among our closest partners.
scene.zh: 好主意。大會是公司內部的，不過他是我們最親近的夥伴之一。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll ask the planning committee today.
scene.zh: 我今天就去問籌備小組。

fills.en: Lantern's sales ___ this year was better than we expected.
fills.zh: Lantern 今年的業績比我們預期的好。

fills.en: The final numbers will ___ sent to you on Friday.
fills.zh: 最終的數字會在星期五寄給你。
fills.note: will 後面接 be + 過去分詞，是被動。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: How's your report for the annual meeting coming along?
scene.zh: 你年度大會的報告準備得怎麼樣了？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I want to show how sales grew month by month.
scene.zh: 我想呈現業績每個月是怎麼成長的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. Sales grew steadily in the first phase, then rapidly after July.
scene.zh: 很好。第一個階段是穩定成長，七月之後就成長得很快。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Show Lantern versus our older lamps, too. That's the real impact.
scene.zh: 也把 Lantern 和我們的舊款燈放在一起比。那才看得出真正的影響。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Do you think I should mention the delay in June?
scene.zh: 您覺得六月延誤的事我要不要提？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, be honest. It was largely a factory problem, and you fixed it fast.
scene.zh: 要，老實講。那主要是工廠的問題，而且你很快就處理好了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: People in our field increasingly care about how a company handles problems.
scene.zh: 我們這一行的人，越來越在意一家公司怎麼處理問題。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then finish with the new models in development. That's your core message.
scene.zh: 最後講正在開發的新款。那是你最主要想講的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks for coming. Let's go through the agenda for the big day.
scene.zh: 謝謝你們過來。我們來看一下大會當天的議程。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll open at nine with our vision, our mission and next year's strategy.
scene.zh: 我九點開場，講公司的願景、使命和明年的策略。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then you're on at ten with Lantern. Any questions?
scene.zh: 然後十點換你上台講 Lantern。有問題嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should the October numbers be included in my slides?
scene.zh: 十月的數字要放進我的投影片嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, please. Timely numbers always make a good impression.
scene.zh: 要。數字越即時，越能給人好印象。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: However, the final October numbers won't be ready until Friday.
scene.zh: 不過十月的最終數字要到星期五才會出來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's fine. Put in September for now, and add October next week.
scene.zh: 沒關係。先放九月的，下星期再把十月的加進去。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ultimately, people want to hear the outlook. Will Lantern go nationwide?
scene.zh: 說到底，大家想聽的是前景。Lantern 會不會賣到全國？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's our big initiative for next year, isn't it?
scene.zh: 那就是我們明年的大計畫，不是嗎？

texts.title: Annual Meeting Agenda
lines: Hi everyone,
Our annual meeting will be held at the Riverside Hotel on Friday, November 21.
9:00 Welcome and the year in review: Mr. Ellis
10:00 Lantern series results: our product coordinator
10:45 A video message from Mr. Hughes
12:00 Lunch (catered)
2:00 Announcements and awards
Several of our business associates and a few shareholders will join us. As stated in the invitation, the meeting is internal, so please do not share the slides outside the company.
Ms. Carter

texts.title: A Letter from Mr. Ellis
lines: Dear coworkers,
This year was hard for many companies in our field. Because of the downturn, some had to downsize, and several stores in town announced their closure.
Thanks to all of you, we did much more than survive. Despite the uncertainty, our sales grew for the fifth consecutive year, and the Lantern series, launched in May, was crucial to this.
Our expansion beyond the US is also going well: the London office opened in August.

Because of this stability, we will invest in two new Lantern models next year. A busy and exciting year awaits us. The details will be explained by our product coordinator at the meeting. I hope to see all of you there.
Mr. Ellis, Founder and Director

questions.en: How did this year's sales compare with past years?
questions.zh: 今年的業績和前幾年比起來怎麼樣？
options: They grew for the fifth year in a row.
They were the same as last year.

questions.en: When did the London office open?
questions.zh: 倫敦辦公室是什麼時候開的？

questions.en: What will the company invest in next year?
What time will the Lantern details be explained?
questions.zh: Lantern 的細節幾點會報告？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I sent out the agenda and Mr. Ellis's letter this morning.
scene.zh: 我今天早上把議程和 Mr. Ellis 的信寄出去了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: His letter is about this year. Many stores in town didn't survive the downturn.
scene.zh: 他的信在講今年。鎮上很多店都沒撐過這波不景氣。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: But our sales grew for the fifth consecutive year.
scene.zh: 可是我們的業績已經連續第五年成長了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So, did you find your name on the agenda?
scene.zh: 那你在議程上找到自己的名字了嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: The agenda has me speaking right before the video from Mr. Hughes.
scene.zh: 議程上排我在 Mr. Hughes 的影片前面上台。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right. It's a nice way to end the morning.
scene.zh: 對。這樣結束上午剛剛好。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: A few shareholders will be there, so be ready for questions.
scene.zh: 會有幾位股東在場，所以要準備好回答問題。

lines.en: So, Jack, tell us more about the merger.
lines.zh: 那，Jack，跟我們多說一點合併的事吧。

lines.en: Sure. Since last month, we've been part of a large corporation.
lines.zh: 好啊。從上個月起，我們就是一家大企業的一部分了。

lines.en: The new owners acquired the building next to our plant in Taoyuan.
lines.zh: 新老闆把我們桃園工廠隔壁那棟廠房買下來了。

lines.en: Really? What are they doing with it?
lines.zh: 真的嗎？他們要拿那棟來做什麼？

lines.en: They're filling it with numerous new machines.
lines.zh: 他們要在裡面放很多新機器。

lines.en: So our monthly output will go up considerably.
lines.zh: 所以我們每個月的產量會大幅增加。

lines.en: Will that change your prices?
lines.zh: 那價格會變嗎？

lines.en: Fortunately, no. Prices and delivery times stay the same.
lines.zh: 幸好不會。價格和交期都一樣。

lines.en: That's good news for Lantern.
lines.zh: 這對 Lantern 來說是好消息。

lines.en: I'm very optimistic. This merger will transform the company.
lines.zh: 我非常樂觀。這次合併會讓公司徹底改頭換面。

questions.en: What happened to Brightway last month?
questions.zh: Brightway 上個月發生了什麼事？
options: It became part of a large corporation.
It opened a store in London.
It closed its plant in Taoyuan.

questions.en: What will happen to Brightway's monthly output?
questions.zh: Brightway 每個月的產量會怎樣？
options: It will go up a lot.
It will go down a little.

questions.en: What does Jack say will not change?

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Jack! Thanks for coming all this way.
scene.zh: Jack！謝謝你特地跑這一趟。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I wouldn't miss it. And I've got some big news.
scene.zh: 我怎麼可能錯過。而且我還帶了個大消息。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let me show you to your seat before we get started.
scene.zh: 開始前我先帶您到座位上。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thanks. So, Brightway went through a merger last month.
scene.zh: 謝謝。是這樣的，Brightway 上個月合併了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's big news! So there's a new president?
scene.zh: 這真的是大消息！所以換了新的總裁？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes. New ownership, new president. It's a lot of change.
scene.zh: 對。新的老闆，新的總裁。變動很大。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: So will the merger change anything for our Lantern orders?
scene.zh: 所以合併之後，我們 Lantern 的訂單會有什麼改變嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Fortunately, no. Same prices, same delivery times.
scene.zh: 幸好不會。價格一樣，交期也一樣。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: That's a relief. Now, coffee's at the back, Jack. Help yourself.
scene.zh: 那就放心了。對了，咖啡在後面，Jack，自己來喔。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: npc

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Although the delay was our fault, your team handled it well.
scene.zh: 雖然延誤是我們的錯，你們團隊處理得很好。

scene.en: Demand was massive, though. Can your designers keep up?
scene.zh: 不過需求量真的很大。你們的設計師跟得上嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: If we had one more designer, we'd get new models out faster.
scene.zh: 如果我們再多一位設計師，新款就能更快推出。

scene.speaker: npc

scene.zh: 從你的投影片就看得出來。我們下星期再談這件事。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And surprisingly, sales in the UK went up dramatically, too.
scene.zh: 而且出乎意料的是，英國那邊的業績也大幅成長。

lines.en: My father started Hughes Home and Garden four decades ago.
lines.zh: 我父親在四十年前創立了 Hughes Home and Garden。

lines.en: He was a young entrepreneur with one small shop.
lines.zh: 他那時是個年輕的創業家，只有一間小店。

lines.en: Today, we're a family enterprise with twelve stores.
lines.zh: 現在，我們是一家有十二間門市的家族企業。

lines.en: For almost two years, we've been fortunate to work with Harbor Trading.
lines.zh: 這將近兩年來，我們很幸運能和 Harbor Trading 合作。

lines.en: This year was extraordinary. The Lantern lamps sold out twice.
lines.zh: 今年真的很了不起。Lantern 的燈賣完了兩次。

lines.en: Our customers' loyalty to the series surprised even me.
lines.zh: 連我都沒想到，客人會這麼忠實地支持這個系列。

lines.en: And I'm pleased to say the Lantern desk lamp has been chosen for a prestigious design award here in the UK.
lines.zh: 我也很高興告訴大家，Lantern 檯燈入選了英國一個很有名望的設計獎。

lines.en: Our new venture with your London office is already underway.
lines.zh: 我們和你們倫敦辦公室的新合作已經開始了。

lines.en: It will only strengthen our ongoing work together.
lines.zh: 這只會讓我們持續的合作更加穩固。

lines.en: The future looks very bright. Thank you, everyone!
lines.zh: 未來一片光明。謝謝大家！

questions.en: What happened to the Lantern desk lamp in the UK?

scene.zh: 你聽大家的掌聲和歡呼！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The support was tremendous. You earned this reward.
scene.zh: 大家的支持非常多。這是你應得的獎勵。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'd like to share this award with Leo and everyone in the warehouse.
scene.zh: 我想把這個獎和 Leo 還有倉庫的每一位同事一起分享。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Well said. One more cheer, everyone!
scene.zh: 說得好。大家再歡呼一次！

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So this is the hall. Let's walk through tomorrow.
scene.zh: 這就是會議廳。我們把明天的流程走一遍。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I open at nine. Then you have the stage at ten.
scene.zh: 我九點開場，十點換你上台。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: How much time will I have for the Lantern results?
scene.zh: Lantern 的成果報告我大概有多少時間？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: You have 45 minutes, with questions at the end.
scene.zh: 你有四十五分鐘，最後留時間問答。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: The agenda has me speaking right before the video from Mr. Hughes.
scene.zh: 議程上排我在 Mr. Hughes 的影片前面上台。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Right, so don't run late. Tell me how you'll start.
scene.zh: 對，所以別超時。跟我說說你要怎麼開頭。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I want to show how sales grew month by month.
scene.zh: 我想呈現業績每個月是怎麼成長的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. The final October numbers came in on Friday, by the way.
scene.zh: 很好。對了，十月的最終數字星期五出來了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should the October numbers be included in my slides?
scene.zh: 十月的數字要放進我的投影片嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Of course. October was your best month.
scene.zh: 當然。十月是你們最好的一個月。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Someone will ask about the June delay, though.
scene.zh: 不過一定會有人問到六月延誤的事。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Despite the June delay, we still hit our sales target.
scene.zh: 雖然六月出貨延誤，我們還是達成了業績目標。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Perfect answer. Then the video plays. Let's hear your line.
scene.zh: 回答得很好。接著要播影片。來聽聽你要怎麼介紹。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Next, we have a short video message from Mr. Hughes in England.
scene.zh: 接下來是 Mr. Hughes 從英國錄的一段影片致詞。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Nice and clear. Now, let's say I'm Jack. Good morning!
scene.zh: 清楚又好聽。現在當作我是 Jack。早安！

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Let me show you to your seat before we get started.
scene.zh: 開始前我先帶您到座位上。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Very good. Then at two, the announcements and awards.
scene.zh: 很好。然後兩點是公告和頒獎。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Luis becomes our safety officer, and we're giving to a charitable foundation.
scene.zh: Luis 要當我們的安全專員，還有公司要捐款給一個慈善基金會。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And your fellow employees nominated Lantern for Project of the Year.
scene.zh: 還有，同事們把 Lantern 提名為年度最佳專案了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I couldn't have done any of this without the whole team.
scene.zh: 沒有整個團隊，這些我一件也做不到。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then say exactly that. See you here at eight.
scene.zh: 那就照這樣說。明天八點這裡見。
